heading: ANNEX LV
subtitle: Legal persons, entities or bodies referred to Article 5aj
units: Part A: legal persons, entities or bodies that seek, or are involved with, the enforcement outside the Union of claims under paragraph 1 of Article 11a, and persons, entities or bodies that own or control those entities or bodies, as referred to in Article 5aj(1).

Part B: legal persons, entities or bodies that seek, or are involved with, the enforcement, outside the Union, of claims under paragraph 1 of Article 11b, and persons, entities or bodies that own or control those entities or bodies, as referred to in Article 5aj(2).
